world.title: Another "Potential Danger" Warning For Mecca, 2nd Time In A Month
world.summary: The Saudi Civil Defence issued a warning for Mecca, marking the second alert in a month, indicating a potential missile threat. Additional warnings were also released for other areas along Saudi Arabia's western coast, including the Red Sea governorate of Yanbu. The alerts were communicated through the National Early Warning Platform to ensure public safety.

world.title: Potential danger alerts issued for Makkah, Jeddah, 3 others
world.summary: Saudi Arabia's National Early Warning Platform issued alerts on September 24 for potential dangers in Makkah City, Taif Governorate, Tabuk Province, Jeddah Governorate, and Tanbu Governorate. Residents in these areas are advised to heed the warnings and follow official guidance. The alerts aim to ensure public safety amid concerns regarding possible hazards in the specified regions.

world.title: Abbas Araghchi in political crisis? Lawmakers submit impeachment motion against Iran's Foreign Minister - here’s why
world.summary: Iranian lawmakers are moving to impeach Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi due to backlash over his diplomatic efforts with the United States. Criticism has intensified from hardliners following his meetings with US officials in New York. Ali Khezrian, a member of the National Security and Foreign Policy Commission, has confirmed the registration of the impeachment motion against Araghchi.

business.title: Moneyview IPO Day 1: Check price band, GMP, subscription status, and other key details
business.summary: Moneyview's IPO opened on September 24, 2026, and was subscribed 1.49 times on its first day. The issue has a grey market premium (GMP) of Rs 14.25, indicating a potential 42% premium. The company aims to raise Rs 1,091.68 crore. Key details include price band, lot size, subscription status, allotment date, and listing information.

business.title: Air India approves Rs 17.74 crore payout for outgoing CEO Campbell Wilson
business.summary: Air India has approved a payout of Rs 17.74 crore for outgoing CEO Campbell Wilson. This includes Rs 15.24 crore to replace shares he was entitled to under a long-term incentive plan for FY23 to FY25, with half originally intended to be paid in shares. Additionally, Wilson received a one-time reward of Rs 2.5 crore for his leadership.

business.title: Bigger Nissan Tekton 7s Spied - New Headlight, Taillight
business.summary: Nissan Motor India is developing a 7-seater version of the Tekton to enhance its market presence and boost sales in India. This follows the recent launches of the Gravite and Tekton models, aimed at attracting more customers to showrooms. The new variant features updated headlight and taillight designs, indicating Nissan's commitment to expanding its product lineup in the region.

technology.title: Mivi Enters India's Smartphone Market with Mivi One 5G
technology.summary: Mivi has launched its first smartphone, the Mivi One 5G, in India. Targeting consumers who prioritize reliable performance and long battery life, the device features a Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 mobile platform. The Mivi One 5G aims to provide a smooth everyday experience, marking the company's entry into the competitive smartphone market in India.

technology.title: Samsung Wallet users in India can now make UPI payments with fingerprint authentication: Here's how it works
technology.summary: Samsung has launched on-device biometric authentication for UPI payments via Samsung Wallet in India. Users can now authenticate eligible UPI transactions using the fingerprint sensor on their Galaxy devices, enhancing security and convenience. This feature eliminates the need for entering PINs for transactions, streamlining the payment process for Samsung Wallet users in the region.

technology.title: Building a Collaborative Platform Culture in a Bank
technology.summary: A platform serves as a collaboration system rather than mere infrastructure. To foster a positive culture, platform teams can implement open support sessions, recognize contributing developers with super user awards, and establish shared open standards. These initiatives aim to enhance collaboration and promote an engineering mindset within the organization, ultimately leading to a more effective and engaged workforce.

sports.title: Nations League Matchday Preview: Netherlands vs. Germany
sports.summary: Germany's national soccer team will face the Netherlands in a Nations League match, marking Jürgen Klopp's debut as Germany's manager. The game is highly anticipated, with fans eager to see the team's new look. Adidas, a prominent sponsor, is set to make a significant impact with its final contributions to the team's branding ahead of the match.

sports.title: India beat Japan in last group match; to face Nepal in semi-finals
sports.summary: The Indian women's kabaddi team won against Japan 50-25 in their final Group A match at the Asian Games 2026, held at Tokai Citizens Gymnasium. This victory secured their place in the semi-finals, where they will face Nepal. The team had already confirmed their semi-final spot prior to this match, demonstrating strong performance throughout the tournament.

sports.title: Animesh Kujur and Gurindervir Singh reach men’s 100m semifinals at Asian Games 2026
sports.summary: Animesh Kujur and Gurindervir Singh advanced to the men’s 100m semifinals at the Asian Games 2026. They secured their spots by finishing third and second in their respective heats on September 24. Kujur's performance in his heat placed him third, while Singh's second-place finish ensured both sprinters moved forward in the competition.

health.title: Goa Becomes First Indian State to Roll Out Comprehensive Adult Vaccination Policy
health.summary: Goa has launched the "Goa Policy for Lifecourse Immunisation 2026-36," becoming the first Indian state to implement a comprehensive adult vaccination policy. This 10-year initiative focuses on voluntary immunisation for high-risk adults and seniors, aiming to enhance public healthcare. The policy establishes operational guidelines and a structured approach to improve vaccination coverage among the adult population in Goa.

health.title: Many surgical interventions are little better than placebo
health.summary: Recent clinical trials reveal that many surgical interventions may offer benefits similar to placebo effects. Historically, the lack of randomized controlled trials (RCTs) in surgical research has obscured the effectiveness of these procedures. As more rigorous studies emerge, they challenge long-held assumptions about the efficacy of surgical treatments, prompting a reevaluation of their role in patient care.

health.title: Your organs may each have their own biological age. The differences were tied to over 1,000 diseases
health.summary: Research indicates that organs can age at different rates, independent of a person's chronological age. This study highlights that biological aging varies among organs such as the heart, liver, and immune system. The findings suggest these differences may be linked to over 1,000 diseases, emphasizing the importance of understanding organ-specific aging for health and disease management.

science.title: In 2005, a high-school student scanning free NASA–ESA images spotted one tiny dot beside the Sun; his report helped confirm a new sungrazing comet
science.summary: In 2005, high school student Quanzhi Ye discovered a new sungrazing comet while scanning free NASA–ESA images, marking a significant achievement in citizen science. His report contributed to the confirmation of the comet and propelled his career in astronomy. This event has inspired thousands of volunteers globally to participate in comet discoveries, transforming the field of astronomical research.

science.title: How mitochondrial heterogeneity fuels a dynamic organelle ecosystem
science.summary: Mitochondria, once seen as a uniform network for energy production, exhibit significant heterogeneity at various biological levels. This includes differences in morphology, metabolism, and organization, adapting to specific functional needs. The Review explores mechanisms of mitochondrial subclasses and their roles in cellular metabolism, advocating for a dynamic ecosystem perspective, which has implications for understanding physiology and disease.

science.title: These massive stars could explain Webb’s strangest galaxies
science.summary: Hubble observations of massive stars in metal-poor dwarf galaxies are providing insights into the early universe's unusual appearance. Researchers discovered that stellar winds significantly weaken at low metallicities, allowing massive stars to retain more material and evolve differently. Additionally, they identified substantial variations in iron abundance, which plays a crucial role in stellar winds and supernovae.

entertainment.title: Anupam Kher praises Govinda as ‘one of the finest actors’ and urges him not to let personal life and habits overshadow his career amid Ssunita Ahuja and Komal Rani Swarnkar controversy: ‘This too shal
entertainment.summary: Anupam Kher praised Govinda as "one of the finest actors" and advised him to not let personal issues overshadow his career. This statement comes amid renewed scrutiny of Govinda's marriage to Sunita Ahuja and ongoing controversies involving Komal Rani Swarnkar. Kher expressed confidence that the challenges will eventually pass, encouraging Govinda to focus on his professional achievements.

entertainment.title: Salman Khan and Arvind Swamy shoot massive train action sequence for Monster; source reveals details of Mumbai schedule
entertainment.summary: Salman Khan and Arvind Swamy are filming a significant train action sequence for the upcoming movie "Monster" in Mumbai. The production is currently in an extensive shooting schedule, focusing on key scenes featuring both actors. Directed by Vamshi Paidipally, the film is generating interest as it progresses through its filming stages. Further details about the project remain limited.

entertainment.title: Lust Stories 3: Lust Is Not Always About Sex
entertainment.summary: Netflix's "Lust Stories 3" explores the intricate dimensions of human desire, emphasizing its influence on relationships, identity, and personal expression. The series aims to present a deeper understanding of lust, moving beyond sexual provocation to address the complexities often overlooked in discussions about desire. This installment seeks to highlight the multifaceted nature of human connections and emotional experiences.
